memory_update.text: NOVT should be carried forward as the strongest US-listed underfollowed precision-motion/sensing candidate for this node because it directly maps to encoders, motors, drives, actuators, force/torque sensors, and robotic end-effectors.

CGNX should be carried forward as the US-listed machine-vision reference/discovery candidate; verify whether AI-enabled and 3D vision are gaining robot-guidance share rather than only serving general factory/logistics automation.

MP should be retained as the US-listed rare-earth magnet-chain reference anchor, but not treated as underfollowed; next layer should compare MP against smaller magnet-chain or recycling/mining/process-equipment names if direct robotics exposure can be evidenced.

This pass did not identify a US-listed pure-play harmonic reducer supplier comparable to Japan/China-listed harmonic-drive leaders; future searches should include ADRs, OTC listings, Japan-listed Harmonic Drive Systems, China-listed LeaderDrive, reducer bearings, strain-wave gear manufacturers, and private/public distributors.

The US-listed direct exposure appears strongest in machine vision, force/torque sensing, motion-control subsystems, robotic end-effectors, and rare-earth magnet supply rather than harmonic reducers themselves.
